subject: [AMBER] Workshop on Free Energy calculations in Muenster March 11-13 2020

messages.author: Vlad Cojocaru
messages.body:
Dear all,
Just a friendly reminder about our workshop on free energy calculations
in Muenster, Germany on March 11-13 2020. I believe we have put together
a great list of invited speakers spanning different disciplines, we will
select short talks from submitted abstracts and we will have a practical
session on performing free energy calculations with "PLUMED".
Please take a look and register on the homepage
https://www.uni-muenster.de/FEW2020/index.html
Looking forward to seeing some of you in Muenster next year
Best wishes
Vlad
